normal.content: Publish one approved post on your Facebook Page (start with the next post in the library).
normal.acquisition: Find 2 local Facebook groups (Prospecting page), read their rules, and record the rule type. Ask to join. Don't post yet.
normal.followup: Reply to every New Lead. Then clear anything on 'Follow-ups due today'.
normal.optional: Take 5 minutes of close-up video on your next job (cup holder, wheel, under-seat). Save it for later.

normal.content: Post one Instagram Story (price graphic or a quick close-up). 2 minutes.
normal.acquisition: Work on one Google/search step from the Prospecting checklist (e.g. confirm GBP eligibility, or set up the Facebook Page's About section).
normal.followup: Send any 'no reply - first nudge' messages that are due.
normal.optional: Pin the price-menu post on your Facebook Page if it's approved.

normal.content: Publish one approved post (Page). If a group you joined allows business posts today, share the group version there.
normal.acquisition: Search 2 joined groups for 'detail', 'car wash', 'clean my car'. Answer real recommendation requests with the group template. One reply each, no arguing.
normal.optional: Drop 5-10 flyers at one place that has a public community board (and allows it).

normal.content: Post a Reel if you have real footage; otherwise skip content today.
normal.acquisition: Visit or message ONE local business from the Prospecting list via its public business contact (partner intro template). Record it.
normal.followup: Check every Quote Sent lead - send the quote follow-up if it's been 2+ days.
normal.optional: Add your real open drop-off times for next week on the Booking page.

normal.content: If you have REAL open slots, post 'Open drop-off times this week' with those exact times. If you're full, post anything else approved.
normal.acquisition: Text past customers whose repeat date has arrived (repeat offer template). Only people who've done business with you.
normal.optional: Ask one happy customer for a referral (referral template).

normal.content: Shoot before/after photos and 1-2 short clips while you work. Hands and car only.
normal.acquisition: Ask today's customers if it's okay to post photos of their car (plates blurred).
normal.followup: Review requests for yesterday's completed jobs.
normal.optional: Pick next week's 3 posts and approve them.

normal.content: No posting required. Approve/schedule 2-3 posts for next week.
normal.acquisition: Open the Weekly Report. Look at which channel brought inquiries and drop the one that took time and brought nothing.
normal.followup: Mark anyone who hasn't replied after 2 follow-ups as Lost. Back up your data (Backup button).
normal.optional: Log any marketing time you forgot to record this week.

cash_mode: 1. Reply to every New Lead right now. Speed wins most small jobs.
2. Send every follow-up due today (quote follow-ups first - they already know the price).
3. Add your REAL open drop-off slots for the next 7 days on the Booking page.
4. Text past customers whose repeat date is close (repeat offer template) - only people who've done business with you.
5. Ask 2-3 happy past customers for a referral (referral template).
6. Post 'Open drop-off times this week' with your real open slots on your Page, and in any group whose rules allow business posts today.
7. Search your joined groups for people asking for a detailer or car cleaning and reply once with the group template.
8. Skip new Reels, logo tweaks and anything that doesn't lead to a message today.
